name: Dr. Referee One
subject: Reference request: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Artificial Intelligence (demo)
body:
Dear Dr. Referee One,

I am applying to Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Artificial Intelligence (demo) (deadline 2027-01-15). Would you be willing to write a reference letter for me as my thesis supervisor? The portal will email you a link once I register you as a referee. I can send my CV and statement of purpose to help.

Thank you,
Your Name
